scenarios.title: A｜确认要求
scenarios.setting: 下课前老师布置了作业，玩家不确定具体要完成哪些内容。

turns.text: For next week, I’d like you to read Chapter 6 and write a short response to the questions on page 85.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步核对作业的范围和篇幅要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Just to make sure, do we need to answer all the questions on page 85?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to make sure, do we need to answer all the questions on page 85?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: How long should the response be?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long should the response be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Do you want us to answer each question separately?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you want us to answer each question separately?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: Should we use information from the chapter in our answers?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should we use information from the chapter in our answers?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: We need answer all the questions?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to make sure, do we need to answer all the questions on page 85?
feedback.explanation: 升调可以表达确认，但完整问句是“Do we need to answer …?”；“need”后接动作需要“to”。

turns.text: Answer the first three questions. Your response should be about 500 words in total.

turns.prompt: 你想核对作业的总字数要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, so about 500 words for all three questions combined?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, so about 500 words for all three questions combined?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Got it. Do we need to include references?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Do we need to include references?
feedback.explanation: “Do we need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Are there any formatting requirements?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any formatting requirements?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: You don’t need formal references, but please include examples from the reading.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for clarifying.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for clarifying.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, that makes sense. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that makes sense. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜确认截止日期
scenarios.setting: 玩家记得有作业，但不确定什么时候交。

turns.text: Excuse me, when is the assignment due?

turns.prompt: 你想确认作业截止当天的具体提交时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is that before class or by the end of the day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that before class or by the end of the day?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

choices.text: What time is it due on Thursday?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time is it due on Thursday?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Just to confirm, that’s next Thursday, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to confirm, that’s next Thursday, right?
feedback.explanation: 先说明是在核对理解，再复述关键信息，便于对方纠正听错或记错的细节。

choices.text: Is there a specific submission deadline?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a specific submission deadline?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Until when should I give you the homework?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that before class or by the end of the day?
feedback.explanation: 作业截止时间常问“When is it due?”；“until when”更像问一个动作持续到何时。

turns.text: Please submit it online by 11:59 p.m. on Thursday.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay, so I can submit it anytime before midnight on Thursday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, so I can submit it anytime before midnight on Thursday?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Got it. What happens if it’s submitted late?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. What happens if it’s submitted late?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Is there a late penalty?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a late penalty?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: Late assignments lose ten percent for each day they’re late.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Understood. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Understood. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll make sure to submit it on time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll make sure to submit it on time.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

scenarios.title: C｜不确定如何提交
scenarios.setting: 在“询问作业”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“不确定如何提交”。

turns.text: Professor, could I check how we’re supposed to submit the assignment?
Sure. What are you unsure about?

turns.prompt: 你想确认作业应以什么方式提交，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do we submit it online or hand in a printed copy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do we submit it online or hand in a printed copy?
feedback.explanation: “hand in”在作业或材料情景中表示提交，而不只是把东西交到别人手上。

choices.text: Where should I upload the file?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where should I upload the file?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Should I send it to you by email?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I send it to you by email?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: What file format should we use?

feedback.naturalExpression: What file format should we use?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Where should I hand my homework?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do we submit it online or hand in a printed copy?
feedback.explanation: 提交作业用“hand in my homework”，不能漏掉“in”。

turns.text: Upload it to the course website. There’s a submission link under Week 4.

turns.prompt: 你想核对作业文件的格式或命名要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Should I upload it as a PDF or a Word document?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I upload it as a PDF or a Word document?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Do we need to include our names in the file name?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do we need to include our names in the file name?
feedback.explanation: “Do we need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Will I get a confirmation after I submit it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a confirmation after I submit it?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: PDF is best. You’ll see a confirmation page once it’s uploaded successfully.

turns.prompt: 关于「询问作业」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll look for the Week 4 submission link.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll look for the Week 4 submission link.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay, thanks. I’ll make sure I see the confirmation page.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks. I’ll make sure I see the confirmation page.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。
